description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandStrategies' that manages command handling strategies for a persistent actor system, delegating commands to specific strategies based on their class. It includes mechanisms to add strategies, check if commands are defined, and apply appropriate strategies during command processing.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class that delegates command handling to specialized strategies, using a mapping of command class types to strategies, to facilitate flexible command processing in a persistent actor context.

methods.name: getEmptyResult
methods.description: Abstract method to return an empty result of type R, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: addStrategy
methods.description: Adds a command strategy to the internal strategies map. Intended to be called only in the constructor.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Returns an empty result and logs that the command cannot be handled by this strategy.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks whether a command of a given class has an associated strategy.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Applies the appropriate command strategy to handle the command or logs as unhandled if no strategy applies.

methods.name: getAppropriateStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the command strategy matching the given command class.
